topic: Expert C++ Implementation Concept: Overload Resolution and Static Member Functions
explanation: This focuses on the intricacies of C++ overload resolution, specifically concerning the restrictions imposed when static member functions are involved.  The compiler's implementation details, memory layout implications (though subtle in this specific case), and the impact on compile-time behavior are explored.  While assembly-level analysis isn't directly applicable to the *conceptual* restriction itself, the compiler's choices during name mangling and symbol table management are indirectly relevant.
